plainEnglish.summary: Where two things are related in meaning - a label and its field, a heading and its section, a cell and its column - the relationship is marked up, not just implied by position or styling.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: A label beside a field, a cell under a column header, a caption under a figure - all of these are obvious by sight and invisible to assistive technology unless the relationship is marked up.
